description: This file defines interfaces, types, and functions for managing and retrieving guide data, including fetching guides by author, getting all guides, and generating table of contents from markdown headings.

methods.name: guidePathToId
methods.description: Generates a unique guide ID from a file path.

methods.name: getGuidesByAuthor
methods.description: Retrieves all guides authored by a specific author ID.

methods.name: getAllGuides
methods.description: Fetches and enriches all guide files, sorting them by date.

methods.name: getGuideById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific guide by its ID.

methods.name: getGuideTableOfContent
methods.description: Creates a table of contents structure from markdown headings.
